title: Best Practices
intro: Universal Age of Empires II improvement principles, grouped by the source each set comes from. These are summarized principles in the spirit of each creator — not verbatim quotes — so you can find more of their work via the linked channels. Apply them on top of any civilization's specific bonuses.

_meta.note: Tips are paraphrased principles attributed to each source for navigation; follow the links for the creators' own explanations.

sections.blurb: Russian-language strategy channel — timings, economy math, and patch analysis (translated here).
tips: On water/hybrid maps Fast Castle is the whole game — but since Docks now fire 0 arrows in the Dark Age you can't shelter fishing ships under the Dock, so play Feudal (Galleys / Fire Ships) to defend them.
Reason in gathering rates, not totals: rate × time decides timings, so chase the fastest food (boar, deer, shore fish) before slow berries.
On resource-rich starts (2+ boar, 8 sheep, 3-4 deer), a Fast-Castle → scouts + scorpions + monks opener snowballs hard.
Fish traps are the most wood-efficient food — 100 wood beats a 60-wood farm and skips all three Mill farm upgrades; if you win the water, keep making fishing ships past ~12.
In draft, civilization reflects a gameplan: ban a player's comfort start to tilt them, and scout their first minutes to disrupt their build.

sections.blurb: Data-driven educational videos — the numbers behind why things work.
tips: Never let the Town Center idle — constant villager production is the single biggest skill in the game.
Counter-composition wins: Skirmishers into Archers, Pikemen into Knights, your own Knights into siege. Read the opponent and build the counter.
Economy upgrades are underused: Double-Bit Axe (Feudal) and Wheelbarrow are among the best-return investments available.
Wall when you boom or fall behind — walls deny raids and buy the time a slower plan needs.
Don't float resources: a bank is army and upgrades you didn't make. If wood climbs, spend it on farms or military.

sections.blurb: Top pro player — fundamentals, decision-making, and macro.
tips: Scout constantly — knowing the opponent's strategy, resources and army is the edge that wins even games.
Macro before micro: keep villagers and military producing before you micro a single fight; production wins the war.
Add Town Centers in Castle Age and keep booming — villager count decides the late game.
Defend your economy first; a clean home base (houses ahead, drop-offs tight) survives aggression and out-scales it.
Control the map's key resources and relics — map control compounds into an economy lead.

sections.blurb: Defensive and boom-focused coaching — reliable plans for climbing the ladder.
tips: Wall + boom is the most reliable plan for newer players: walls let you macro in peace and reach a power spike.
Hit your build-order timings — click Feudal/Castle at the right villager count so your spike lands on schedule.
Never fight a bad matchup: retreat, re-tech to the counter, and re-engage on your terms.
Use Towers and Castles to lock down hills, relics and forward resources — stone is map control.
Keep base discipline: houses ahead of the pop cap, drop-off buildings tight to resources, zero TC idle time.
